claims.text: Ponto was the eldest son of Posco Baggins and Gilly Brownlock and was named after his great-grandfather, Ponto. He was the father of Angelica and they attended the Birthday Party together.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix C, "Baggins of Hobbiton"

claims.text: After Frodo Baggins left the Shire in , Ponto "presumably" became the head of the Baggins Family, though in title only, as Bag End had passed to Samwise Gamgee.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien; Humphrey Carpenter, Christopher Tolkien (eds.), The Letters of J.R.R. Tolkien, Letter 214, (undated, written late 1958 or early 1959)
